summary.text: Campbell Gome is the Greens candidate for Northcote at the 2026 Victorian election. He teaches in public schools, is a union member and activist, and has lived in the area for close to 30 years. This is his third run for the Greens: he was on the party's Northern Metropolitan upper-house ticket in 2018 and lost Northcote to Labor by 184 votes in 2022.

priorities.text: Northcote deserves a representative who will fight to end new coal and gas projects
Affordable housing, protection for renters and help for first home buyers
Reversing what the Greens call Labor's cuts to school funding

summary.text: Christopher Bradbury is the One Nation candidate for Northcote at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. His party profile says he has spent his working life in the transport industry and has not been a career politician. Wikipedia lists a Chris Bradbury as One Nation's candidate for McEwen at the 2022 federal election and second on its Southern Metropolitan ticket at the 2022 state election, and a Christopher Bradbury second on the party's Victorian Senate ticket in 2025, though no source we found confirms these are the same person.

summary.text: Jim Penman is the Libertarian Party's candidate for Northcote at the 2026 Victorian election. He founded Jim's Group, the home-services franchise that began as Jim's Mowing in 1989, and earned his doctorate in history at La Trobe University. He has written books on epigenetics and falling birth rates and funds research in that field. Wikipedia says he joined the Libertarians in October 2025 and was endorsed for Northcote in February 2026.

summary.text: Kat Theophanous is the Labor MP for Northcote, which she took from the Greens at the 2018 state election and held in 2022. She was Parliamentary Secretary for Women's Health from 2022 and has been Parliamentary Secretary to the Premier since August 2026. She is recontesting Northcote in 2026.

prior_roles.role: Adviser to Fiona Richardson, then Northcote MP and women's minister
Government relations and corporate affairs at SBS

priorities.text: Managing Northcote's growth while keeping open space and adding services
Affordable housing and action on homelessness
Public education, modern transport and health including mental health

summary.text: Kath Larkin is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Northcote at the 2026 Victorian election. She grew up in the area, rents, and spent close to ten years working on the railways, becoming the first woman to serve as a delegate for the rail and tram union (RTBU) at Flinders Street Station; in 2015 she was among the leaders of a strike. This is her sixth campaign for the party, following state runs in Thomastown (2018) and Northcote (2022) and three federal contests in Cooper (2019, 2022, 2025).

occupation.text: Trade unionist; formerly a railway worker

prior_roles.role: Union delegate at Flinders Street Station

priorities.text: More public housing and a freeze on rents
Reversing privatisation of essential services and utilities
Protecting and expanding local green spaces
Opposing the far right through community organising

summary.text: Lynda Awad is the Liberal candidate for Northcote at the 2026 Victorian election. She has worked in banking as a financial consultant and in the arts as an international curator, and came back to Melbourne in 2019 after more than ten years overseas. She is a volunteer with a Melkite Catholic parish in Fairfield and its seniors' group.

occupation.text: Financial consultant and international arts curator
